answer: Non-kin attestation quorums resist sybils: an identity counts only once enough established, UNRELATED peers vouch for it, and self-referential rings are discounted. A fake cluster is a closed loop vouching only for itself, no wider than a wharf, so it earns nothing — it draws no genuine edges from beyond its own horizon. Honest identities gather many independent vouches like wind filling a gale; a ring has only its own, and the rule starves it.
